children: According to Kabutan, Yonhap and HKET, Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller told CNBC that policymakers should raise rates by 50 basis points in December and stop there if they cannot give markets a credible signal of a further hike in January. AI company Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, above its earlier $70–$78 range, ahead of its Nasdaq listing on Nov. 19.

Nikkei 225 futures for December 2026 delivery on the Osaka Exchange ended the night session at 58,880, down 370 points and 144.28 points below the Nikkei average's cash close of 59,024.28, with 13,820 contracts traded. TOPIX futures finished the night session at 3,799, down 27.5 points.

KOSPI 200 night futures fell 1.41%. The MSCI South Korea ETF rose 1.04%, while the MSCI Emerging Markets ETF fell 0.67%. Seoul's stock market will open one hour later than usual, at 10 a.m. local time on Nov. 19, for the college entrance exam, with trading hours for KOSPI 200 futures and other equity and interest-rate derivatives also pushed back by one hour.

Hang Seng Index November futures closed the after-hours session at 23,100, down 126 points, trading between 23,052 and 23,231 on volume of 16,713 contracts. The NASDAQ Golden Dragon China Index fell 1.35% to 5,291. Following its earnings release, Tencent's ADR equated to HK$361.92, 2.92% below its Hong Kong close. Alibaba's U.S. shares equated to HK$82.74, down 2.94%, the HSBC ADR to HK$132.84, down 2.32%, and Meituan's ADR to HK$69.24, down 1.30%.
Taiwan's TAIEX futures for December 2026 ended the night session at 39,987, down 345 points or 0.86%, trading between 39,411 and 40,689 on volume of 56,051 contracts.

title: ASIA NIGHT SESSION | KOSPI 200 Night Futures Fall 1.41%, Nikkei Futures Drop 370 Points
